titulo_es: Depending on, contribute to: verbal regency

orçamento.consejo: Expected amount of income and expenditure.

texto: **Depender de** (depending on), **contribuir para** (contribute to), **insistir em** (insist on), **assistir a** (attend / see, in European Portuguese): **O resultado depende dos dados**; **Assistimos ao debate**. The preposition is maintained before a name and, in many cases, an infinitive: **Insistiu em participar**.

The Portuguese preposition does not always coincide with the Spanish one. Learn each regime with the verb and check the meaning: **assistir a um filme** means watching a film; **assistir alguém** can mean helping or providing assistance.

filas: A medida contribui para a melhoria.

frases.pt: A execução do plano depende do orçamento aprovado.
frases.es: La ejecución del plan depende del presupuesto aprobado.
frases.en: The implementation of the plan depends on the approved budget.

frases.pt: A equipa insiste em publicar os dados e acredita que isso contribuirá para a transparência.
frases.es: El equipo insiste en publicar los datos y cree que eso contribuirá a la transparencia.
frases.en: The team insists on publishing the data and believes that this will contribute to transparency.

frases.pt: Ontem, os moradores assistiram ao debate na câmara municipal.
frases.es: Ayer, los vecinos vieron el debate en el ayuntamiento.
frases.en: Yesterday, the neighbors saw the debate at the city hall.

bloques.pregunta: What does the implementation of the plan depend on?

opciones.explicacion: The text speaks of that in the second sentence.
It is later mentioned as another fact.

opciones.texto: They saw the debate at the city hall.
opciones.explicacion: «Assistiram ao debate» here means they saw it.
It does not appear in the text.
This action is attributed to the team.

bloques.frase: A equipa insiste em publicar os dados.

opciones.texto: The team insists on publishing the data.
The team insists on publishing the data.
The team depends on publishing the data.
opciones.explicacion: It changes the verb and the structure.

bloques.traduccion: We saw the debate at the city hall.

opciones.explicacion: «Contribuir para» expresses a contribution to a result.

intro: Some verbs select a specific preposition. Learn the verb + preposition set with an example.
